stylePrompt: Create a NEW 2-by-2 sheet of tarot line illustrations using the attached approved sheet ONLY as a STYLE REFERENCE. Replace all four subjects with the requested cards below. Maintain the same restrained fluid contours, rounded line endings and joins, human quality, generous negative space, sparse inner details and consistent fully opaque BLACK lines about 3 to 4 pixels wide at 1024px sheet width. This must be clean, readable outline drawing on TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA. Do not simulate any material. Background and interiors of all shapes fully transparent; no white background, no dark or smoky background, no shading, gradients, glow, crosshatching, sketching, repeated lines, filled silhouettes, title lettering, numerals, grid dividers, card frames or borders. Minimal recognizable upright Rider-Waite-Smith compositions, preserving essential gestures, objects and meaningful symbol counts. Each numbered suit card must have EXACTLY its specified count of suit symbols. All pentacles are circular disks with a FIVE-pointed star. Generous internal margin and broad empty gutters; keep ALL art inside equal-sized portrait cells. Overall canvas portrait 2:3, two columns and two rows; each cell portrait 2:3. Keep scale and stroke weight uniform across all cards. No objects touch or cross cell boundaries. Reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Do not add any text or labels.
coordinateConvention: Zero-based row/column; crop rectangles are source-image pixels.
